## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Shri Akshayaa Mahal?
6, Fifth Main Road, Thillaiganga Nagar, Nanganallur, Chennai 600 061 (Open Mon – Sun, 6 AM to 10 PM).

### What facilities does Shri Akshayaa Mahal have?
Air-conditioned hall, Pillar-less hall, East-facing wedding stage, Lift, Power backup, Valet parking, Fully equipped kitchen, Jamakkalam & bedding included, Labour & cleaning included, Open 6 AM – 10 PM, all week.

### What does the rent include?
Rent covers the building, rooms, chairs, labour, cleaning, consumables, jamakkalam and bedding, a fully equipped kitchen, valet parking and water for general use.

### Who runs Akshayaa Mahal?
It was founded in 2005 by Mr. Balaji and Mrs. Uma Balaji, and has been managed since 2012 by Gowtham Balaji and Sandhya Manian.

### How do I check if Shri Akshayaa Mahal is free on my date?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 93607 76428.
